notes: All supervised baselines are trained on the corrected Guizhou embroidery multi-task split (train 34330 / val 736 / test 736).
UniNet is evaluated only on the defect (anomaly detection) task because it is a one-class anomaly detector; auth/pattern heads are not applicable.
UniNet used wide_resnet50_2 for both teacher and student, 224x224 input, batch size 8, 5 epochs, and a 2000-image normal-only training subset due to GPU memory/training-time constraints.
Best defect accuracy for each supervised method is reported from the per-epoch checkpoints; the main row reports the last-epoch test metrics.
